issues: scene_002: Assigning the voice to Jesus Christ is plausible from broader context but not identified in these supplied verses; keep the speaker unspecified. The visual inference that the people listen is reasonable, but the text does not describe their actions during this speech.
The speaker is unidentified in verses 5–7; do not assume it is the same speaker identified in the preceding scene as Jesus Christ.
The invitation and warning are conditional/future statements, not events to depict as happening now.
